decisions.reason: Adjustable quarter-pallet cardboard displays are a flexible standard item in the POS display range and fit the firm's core corrugated business.
Pegboard-back shelf displays serve ongoing retail demand for hanging small goods and are cheap to keep in a made-to-order catalog.
The basic quarter-pallet cardboard display is a core high-volume format in German retail promotions.
Eighth-pallet displays fill a common small-footprint niche, complement the quarter-pallet line and need little extra resource.
A wooden pallet is outside the paper core and could be cut in a portfolio cleanup, but it still supports display sales as an accessory.
Demand for displays of physical media is shrinking, which puts this product at risk, but the generic cardboard design keeps it inexpensive to retain for now.
